description: Source code for an Android Fragment class that displays detailed information about a recipe, including images, metadata, ingredients, and instructions. It manages UI components, observes ViewModel state, and handles user interactions within an Android app.

classes.name: DetailFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment class responsible for displaying detailed recipe information, managing UI elements, observing ViewModel, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets up the ViewModel with a mock repository.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up views, buttons, and observes ViewModel state; triggers recipe loading.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns UI components from the layout.

methods.name: setupButtons
methods.description: Sets up button click listeners for back navigation and favorite toggling.

methods.name: observeViewModel
methods.description: Launches a coroutine to observe changes in UI state from the ViewModel and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator and hides other views.

methods.name: showRecipe
methods.description: Populates UI elements with recipe data and manages views' visibility.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DetailFragment with specified recipe ID.
